en: An old sepia-toned street scene showing a town road lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings on both sides. At the far end stands a larger, more ornate building with a tower-like roof. A horse-drawn cart is on the right side of the street and a child stands on the sidewalk. The title printed at the top in red reads "Geithain, Chemnitzer Strasse." Additional German shop signs are visible on the building fronts.
